notes: A vehicle reverses far out in the GT camera's view, 115-175 m from the visible cameras and outside every configured zone, with no annotated cue in any visible camera. Correct answers are abstention or 'no event in the instrumented region'; naming a pocket event would be a false positive. A large group of pedestrians walking through cam_b is a visible distractor (inspection).
indirect_cues_note: Every MEVA-annotated activity in a visible camera that overlaps the window and maps within 30 m of the event point. Concurrency only: not a claim that the activity was caused by the event.

derivation.method: MEVA kitware activity annotations in the GT camera clip; event point = bottom-center of the first actor's box at mid-activity, ray-cast onto the MEVA coarse ground mesh
derivation.visibility_test: projection of the event point (+0/1/1.6 m) into each visible camera's KRTD model, plus same-kind co-annotation within 3 s / 10 m
